scope: Provider metadata, staged completion orchestration, request accounting, injected execution identity, and legacy strategy boundaries. Dataset additions and future paid drivers require their own validation.

findings.problem: Provider _as_int coerced floats/strings to known integers, allowing malformed usage to bypass unknown-usage stop.
findings.resolution: Transport now accepts only type(value) is int and value >= 0; 10 invalid values are unknown and 0/2 are preserved. Original judge prompts/parsers and historical results were not changed by this review.

findings.problem: Changing injected plan token budget did not change OracleRunner.resume_key, so records from different phase profiles could be mixed.
findings.resolution: execution_configuration is now included in configuration hash; plan budget, declared reasoning effort, call cap, and passage length changes all independently reject resume while unchanged ReaderSpec fingerprint demonstrates the missing identity was addressed.

checked_invariants: Three mandatory phases remain; all successful recovered runs complete review within four total calls.
One global recovery slot is shared by empty, length and JSON/schema correction; second truncation stops without returning a cached draft.
finish_reason=length is not accepted even when content is parseable valid JSON.
Recovery input is reconstructed from admitted evidence and original phase inputs; partial output sentinel is never replayed.
Unknown total usage, content_filter, and unexpected finish reasons never invoke recovery; known usage remains recorded.
Transport failure is not retried implicitly; RequestLedger RunStopped derives from BaseException and is not converted into a semantic refusal.
Reasoning token counts are metadata, not additional billable output; reasoning content is not stored or returned.
Null content with explicit finish reason preserves known totals; missing content or null without termination still errors.
Evidence binding preserves execution configuration, per-phase specs, and shared limits.
Legacy strategies have no execution configuration added and retain the existing prompt protocol and stage transport routing.
Provider is injected; no benchmark IDs, gold answers, old outputs or credentials enter the new execution policy.
Phase model spec, route profile and declared reasoning effort are public identity; clients and credentials are not serialized.
limitations: Scripted checks establish control flow and accounting boundaries, not semantic retrieval/answer accuracy.
Normal-mode planning may omit necessary search/read actions; old 32 challenges without tool use do not establish its semantic quality.

Maximum output reservation is 49152 tokens per case (40960 for mandatory stages plus 8192 recovery), costing up to 0.393216 CNY at 8 CNY/million before input. A 7.25 CNY pilot or 29 CNY full-run cap cannot be guaranteed sufficient; real requests must retain prospective budget checks.
The model service alias may change; reported resolved model/revision must not be described as an immutable pinned model without evidence.
Future paid proposal/driver, final full quality run, clean install and exact-SHA CI remain outside this independent code-review conclusion.
